case.summary: Transaction 3478782 for $292.36 online was flagged by the model at score 0.79 and matches the card_not_present_fraud pattern at strength 0.42. The transaction is notably unusual for this cardholder: at $292.36, it exceeds the median transaction amount of $36.98 by more than four times across the account's 44-transaction history. The account has one prior confirmed card-not-present fraud case (CC-4160) and shares a device with another cardholder who committed confirmed fraud. Prior case memory retrieved 8 structurally similar closed cases filtered by shared device and pattern match, all 8 of which were confirmed fraud with no false alarms. The fraud probability assessment stands at 0.53 with verdict uncertain, and the policy on card-not-present fraud calls for verification when a single unusual online purchase occurs without additional context such as a burst pattern. Based on the transaction anomaly relative to baseline spending, the shared device connection to prior fraud, and the 100 percent fraud confirmation rate among structurally similar prior cases, the evidence supports moderate confidence in fraud, though the absence of a rapid transaction burst leaves some ambiguity. A case has been opened for investigation with connected cards placed under monitoring.
